title: Chapter 115: Room 303
html:
A streetlight stretched Chen Ge’s shadow across the pavement. The road was deserted except for the occasional stray cat scurrying through the rubbish.

Who would expect a street this quiet inside the city?He followed the road deeper into the residential complex. A faint stench hung in the air. Old rubbish spilled from torn bags, with vermin occasionally writhing through it. The building he sought was more dilapidated than those facing the main road, its walls stained and its steps choked with trash.

Found it.An advertisement pasted to the wall confirmed the six-story building’s address. The black phone named Room 303. That must be Men Nan’s apartment.

Chen Ge glanced at the time; it was 7:54 pm. It might be rather inconvenient after Doctor Gao arrives, so perhaps I should go take a look around first.

Without calling Doctor Gao, he entered the stairwell. Each floor had a ceiling barely over two meters high. Red strings had been tied at intervals along the iron railing for some unknown purpose. A peculiar odor met him inside—faint rather than foul, and probably invisible to longtime residents, but obvious to a newcomer.

Like spoiled food.He searched the first floor without finding a source. The smell seemed to seep from the bricks themselves. With the corridor lights broken, he used his phone as a flashlight.

Four apartments crowded each floor. The walls were thin enough for voices to carry into the corridor.

Chen Ge snuck up to the third floor. He did not knock on the door to Room 303 but stood outside the door to listen in.

On the third floor, a television blared from Room 301. A man argued over the phone in 302, repeating the same two lines: “Stop forcing me. Are you two trying to drive me to my death?”

There was no sound coming from Room 303 and 304; they were very quiet.

After listening for two minutes, Chen Ge tapped lightly on Room 303. The television in 301 quieted, and the man next door ended his call. Silence fell over the entire floor.

Chen Ge knocked on the door for a full minute, but there was no answer. He called out softly, “Men Nan? Are you home?”

There was no answer. Just as Chen Ge thought he had gotten the wrong address, the door to 301 opened.

An unshaven middle-aged man leaned against the frame, wrapped in the smell of alcohol. “Who are you looking for?”

“Men Nan in 303, he’s a student at Jiujiang Medical University. I heard he’s not feeling well, so I came to visit him.”

“You have the wrong place. I don’t know any Men Nan, but he definitely doesn’t live in 303.” The man scratched a bleeding mosquito bite on his left cheek.

“But my friend told me he lives here.” Chen Ge tried to get some information from the man. “Furthermore, you said you don’t know Men Nan, so how can you be sure he doesn’t live here?”

“Someone died in 303. It has been empty ever since.” He inspected the blood beneath his fingernails. “Stop knocking. It’s bad luck. Understand?”

He slammed the door. The television remained quiet, however; the man was probably listening from the other side.

Chen Ge stopped knocking. He had learned something important: a death had left Room 303 vacant.

He had found the mission venue, so the key now was how to gain entry before midnight.

The black phone hasn’t made any mistakes yet, so Men Nan’s illness is probably related to this room.Chen Ge looked at his watch; it was already 8 pm, so he called Doctor Gao.

Worried that Chen Ge might get lost, Doctor Gao had been waiting at the entrance to the complex.

Several minutes after Chen Ge explained the situation, Doctor Gao entered the corridor with Men Nan behind him. The young man’s appearance shocked Chen Ge. His posture had deteriorated until it resembled a severe physical deformity.

His head hung nearly perpendicular to his spine, as if crushed beneath an invisible weight. Chen Ge pointed at the door and gave Doctor Gao a questioning look.

Doctor Gao understood and shook his head. “His condition worsened. Medication has stabilized him for now. Let’s go inside.”

Head bowed, Men Nan took out his key. In the dim light he repeatedly missed the lock. His hands began shaking with anger, warning of another outburst. Chen Ge immediately stepped forward and opened Room 304 for him.

Doctor Gao and Men Nan had probably grown accustomed to the odor, but it overwhelmed Chen Ge the moment they entered.

It’s seeping from the walls.The apartment was clean and orderly, with even the wastebasket empty. Nothing explained the smell. Another body sealed behind plaster?

He dismissed the idea. Wang Qi had deliberately thickened the wall at Ping An Apartments. An ordinary apartment partition could not conceal a body.

Noticing his strange behavior, Doctor Gao asked, “What are you looking for?”

“Do you not smell a very weird odor?” Chen Ge stopped at the wall between 303 and 304; the smell was the most intense there.

“Yes, but old buildings often smell strange.” Doctor Gao guided Men Nan toward the bed, but the young man refused to approach. He preferred standing to sitting on it.

Chen Ge glanced at Men Nan, and he whispered to the doctor, “What’s going on with him?”

“He’s afraid to sleep. In his last dream, the man began strangling him. Men Nan fears the next time he closes his eyes, he won’t wake again.”
